slides.headline: A Surat textile godown caught fire. Lakhs in stock, damaged.
10 to 12 fire tenders,
slides.body: Kharwasa Canal Road, Surat. The cause is still under investigation.

slides.headline: Loose fibre + tight stacks
slides.body: Big stacks of textile let the flames spread quickly. Blocked aisles stop crews reaching the seat of the fire.

slides.headline: Keep wiring away
slides.body: Cables in conduit. No loose sockets near fabric.

slides.headline: Break up the stacks,
slides.body: Smaller stacks with gaps slow the spread and let crews in.

slides.headline: Declare your storage
slides.body: Undeclared stock can turn your fire claim into a dispute.

slides.headline: Electrical audit
slides.body: Thermal-scan the panels. Fix loose connections.

slides.headline: Send this to a godown owner
